name: Delish
observations: Red-brick two-storey terrace with dark shallow roof and brick chimneys.
Broad pale sign reads DELISH; lower display windows are covered by pale fabric/blind-like material in these views.
Narrow central framed entrance interrupts two broad lower glazing panels.
Upper white-framed rectangular windows and light lintel/sill pieces contrast with brick.
Keep covered-window state as dated appearance, not blank wall geometry.
Adjoins Studio and Grove without a large public alley.
unknowns: Exact dimensions, rear elevation and interior layout are not established. Street View address is a camera label, not this unit address.
review_basis: All listed captures reviewed in contact sheets; selected originals also inspected at native resolution. Notes describe visible appearance, not surveyed construction.
placement_confidence: Approximate frontage marker derived from camera route, side and estimated offset; not a measured footprint.
